item.title: Best AI Meeting Assistants 2026: Otter.ai vs Fireflies.ai vs Fathom Compared
item.description:
The best AI meeting assistants in 2026 are Fathom for unlimited free use, Fireflies.ai for cross-team collaboration and CRM integration, and Otter.ai for industry-leading real-time transcription. With the AI meeting assistant market surging past $3.9 billion in 2026, choosing the right tool can reclaim hours lost to manual note-taking every week.

Why Do You Need an AI Meeting Assistant in 2026?

The average knowledge worker spends 21 hours per week in meetings (TrendHarvest, 2026). That is more than half a standard workweek — and a significant portion of that time is consumed by taking notes, formatting summaries, and following up on action items. AI meeting assistants automate all three, letting participants focus entirely on the conversation.
